🐧 Unix 1 › 🙋 Cloud-Me 1.2 › Pub 1.2.1

Cloud-Me-Pub hub: index of the public cloud-me family

CodeVisibilityParent hubDeveloperFarm folder
1.2.1.0🌐 publiccloud-me-___ 1.2.0Leaf.y1.2.Cloud-me/Pub/

Registry index for the public cloud-me family (Cloud-Me-Pub) - same model as CG-___, Fin-CM-___ and cloudy-___. This repo is an INDEX, not a container: it holds repos.json (the registry, a subset of _git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json), clone.sh (pick which repos to have locally) and one committed relative symlink per member (<member> -> ../<member>); the actual clones live as siblings in ~/git/.

Parent hub: cloud-me-___, the top hub of the cloud-me project (the owner's configs across the cloud).

Members

2 member(s), from the registry (0_registry/projects-repos.json in _git-repos-master).

Usage

./clone.sh                list what exists and what does not
./clone.sh <name>...      clone those, then link them
./clone.sh --all          clone every member
./clone.sh --link         relink whatever is already cloned
./clone.sh --relink       rewrite every link from the registry
./check-repos-sot.sh      verify repos.json against _git-repos-master

repos.json is a SUBSET of ~/git/_git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json (the superset index of every repo this account owns): identical name/url/private/doc fields, checked by ./check-repos-sot.sh.

Clone depth

clone.sh clones with --depth 1 --shallow-submodules by default: only the latest commit, so a clone is fast and takes little disk. Each repo has exactly ONE clone (in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE); the links point at it, so never keep a second full copy next to it.

./clone.sh <name>...                 # shallow, depth 1 (default)
./clone.sh --full <name>...          # full history (same as CLONE_DEPTH=0)
CLONE_DEPTH=50 ./clone.sh <name>...  # a deeper shallow clone
git -C <clone> fetch --unshallow     # later, turn an existing clone into full history
git -C <clone> submodule update --init --depth 1   # submodules stay shallow too

Hub submodule

This repo's parent hub is cloud-me-___, mounted as a git submodule at 0_hub/cloud-me-___ (one fixed path convention for every repo; URL https://github.com/diegonmarcos/cloud-me-___.git, pinned to its main). Only the upward link is a submodule; this hub keeps symlinks (not submodules) to its members, so there are no cycles. Source of truth: 0_registry/projects-repos.json in _git-repos-master (rendered into repos.json parent_hub / hub), guarded by node 0_registry/repos-sot.js check-hubs.
